text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper
